ordersText.title: DIVINE DELIVERANCE
ordersText.general: When rolling dice during the preparation step of a combat you start with this order, roll 1 additional die for each Sister Repentia on the contested world. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: FAITHFUL ADVANCE
ordersText.general: While resolving this order, you may move up to 2 of your units through 1 uncontrolled world as if it were a friendly area. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: LEAD THE RIGHTEOUS
ordersText.general: After you resolve this order, you may place 1 free reinforcement token on a friendly world in the active system that contains a bastion and no reinforcement token. When this world becomes contested, this reinforcement token participates in combat. If the bastion is destroyed outside of combat, return the reinforcement token to the supply. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: WAR HYMNS
ordersText.general: During this orbital strike, gain 1 [D]. Before you resolve this orbital strike, if the combined morale of your ships participating in this orbital strike is higher than the combined morale of unrouted units and bastions on the world, force your opponent to rout 1 of his units. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: BRAZIER OF HOLY FIRE
ordersText.general: Enemy bastions do not prevent this orbital strike. During this orbital strike, you may rout any number of participating ships. For each ship you rout, convert up to 2 of your dice into [B]. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

eventsText.title: UNDIVIDED FAITH
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* You may discard this card at the start of an execution round of combat. If you do, your routed units contribute half of their morale value, rounded up, to your total morale during the resolution step of this combat.

eventsText.title: HEROINE IN THE MAKING
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Instead of revealing an order during the Operations Phase, you may discard this card to move 1 Sister Repentia or 1 Battle Sister to an enemy world and start combat. While resolving this combat, resolve 1 execution round only and treat the chosen unit as a Living Saint. Destroy it after you resolve the combat.

eventsText.title: INDOMITABLE BELIEF
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* You may discard this card at the start of an execution round of combat. If you do, your units cannot become routed during this execution round.

eventsText.title: FAIT ACCOMPLI
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Before revealing an order during the Operations Phase, you may discard this card to take either 1 Sister Repentia or 1 Battle Sister from any world and place it on any friendly world.

eventsText.title: INVASION CATHEDRUM DEPLOYMENT
eventsText.general: Either place 1 free city on a friendly world not containing a structure or spend 3 materiel to place 1 free city on a friendly world not containing a city.

eventsText.title: CRUSADE INTO DARKNESS
eventsText.general: Purchase 1 combat upgrade, reducing its materiel cost by 1 for each system containing both friendly and enemy areas. The reduction cannot exceed 3 materiel.

eventsText.title: INSPIRING ORATOR
eventsText.general: Either gain 1 reinforcement token or gain 1 reinforcement token for each friendly world containing a city.

eventsText.title: ULTIMATE DEVOTION
eventsText.general: Either place 1 free Battle Sister on a friendly world containing a unit or place 1 free Sister Repentia on any friendly world.

combatText.title: DRIVEN ONWARDS
combatText.general: Gain 2 [B].
combatText.unit: Sister Repentia/Light Cruiser: When 1 of your Sisters Repentia or Light Cruisers is destroyed during the assess damage step of this execution round, destroy 1 of your opponent's command level 0 units.

combatText.title: BEACON OF FAITH
combatText.unit: Resolve one of the following: *newline* Sister Repentia: Replace 1 of your Sisters Repentia on this world with 1 free Battle Sister and gain 2 [D]. *newpara* Bastion/Light Cruiser: Gain 1 [M] and 2 (S).

combatText.title: GUIDED RETRIBUTION
combatText.unit: Bastion/Sister Repentia/Light Cruiser: Gain either 1 (B) or 1 (S). *newline* Play 1 combat card from your hand. Then discard this card.

combatText.title: HOLY TRINITY
combatText.general: Force your opponent to reroll up to 3 [B]
combatText.unit: Bastion/Battle Sister/Light Cruiser: Gain 1 (S) for each [B] rolled by your opponent while resolving the general ability of this card.

combatText.title: SANCTIFIED CHARGE
combatText.general: Either gain 1 [D] or reroll 1 die of your choice. *newline* Either gain 1 [D] or reroll 1 die of your choice.
combatText.unit: Sister Repentia/Light Cruiser: For each [B], [S], and [M] rolled while resolving the general abilities of this card, gain 1 (B), 1 (S), or 1 [D], respectively.

combatText.title: ZEALOT'S PASSION
combatText.general: Gain 1 (B). *newpara* Force your opponent to lose 1 [M].
combatText.unit: Battle Sister/Light Cruiser: During this execution round, your opponent cannot rally his units or place reinforcement tokens in this area. *newline* If you are defending, rally 1 of your units.

combatText.title: MARTYRDOM
combatText.general: Convert up to 2 of your [B] into [M].
combatText.unit: Battle Sister/Light Cruiser: When 1 of your units is destroyed during the assess damage step of this execution round, gain 1 [S]. Damage in excess of that unit's health value is lost.

combatText.title: SPIRITUAL FORTITUDE
combatText.general: Force your oppononent to lose either 1 [B] or 1 [M]. *newpara* If you are defending, your opponent loses 2 (B).
combatText.unit: Battle Sister/Light Cruiser: Gain 2 [D].

combatText.title: ANGELIC DESCENT
combatText.general: Gain 1 (S) for each of your unrouted units, to a maximum of 3.
combatText.unit: Battle Sister/Light Cruiser:  Gain 2 (B). During the assess damage step of this execution round, your opponent assigns damage 1 at a time. The damage is not accumulated between assignments.

combatText.title: MARTYR'S IMMOLATION
combatText.general: Gain 3 (S) unless your opponent spends 1 die of his choice. If he does, gain 1 [M].
combatText.unit: Resolve one of the following: *newline* Battle Sister/Light Cruiser: Spend 1 [S] to gain 2 (B). *newline* Exorcist/Grand Cruiser: Gain 2 (B). *newline* For each unit destroyed during this execution round, do not discard 1 of your (B) at the end of this execution round.

combatText.title: ARMOURED IN FAITH
combatText.general: Gain 1 [M] and 1 (S).
combatText.unit: Resolve one of the following: *newline* Battle Sister/Light Cruiser: Rally 1 of your units. *newpara* Exorcist/Grand Cruiser: If you have more [M] than your opponent, your opponent chooses and routs 1 of his units.

combatText.title: DEVASTATING REFRAIN
combatText.general: Gain 1 (B) for each of your opponent's units, to a maximum of 4.
combatText.unit: Resolve one of the following: *newline* Bastion: Gain 1 (S) for each [M] you have. *newline* Sister Repentia/Battle Sister/Light Cruiser: Gain 1 [D].

combatText.title: DIVINE BLESSING
combatText.general: Spend any number of [S] or [M]. For each [S] or [M] you spend, force your opponent to lose 1 [B].
combatText.unit: Living Saint/Grand Cruiser: Gain 4 [D].

combatText.title: DIVINE SMITING
combatText.general: Either gain 1 [M] or convert up to 2 of your dice into [M].
combatText.unit: Living Saint/Grand Cruiser: Gain 1 (B) for each [M] you have. *newline* During this execution round, none of the [B] are added to offence values.

ordersText.title: CYBERNETIC AFFINITY
ordersText.general: When you reveal this order token, you may either replace 1 Skitarii in the active system with 1 free Kataphron or destroy 1 of your units in the active system to purchase 1 additional upgrade card, reducing its materiel cost by the materiel cost of the destroyed unit. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: MASTER OF THE MACHINES
ordersText.general: While resolving this order, you may either increase your deploy limit by 1 or reduce the total materiel cost of purchased units and structures by 1. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: INFOSLAVE SKULLs
ordersText.general: After drawing cards during the preparation step of a combat you start with this order, you may either reroll 1 die for each of your units in the contested area or draw 2 combat cards and then discard 2 combat cards. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: BLESSED CONDUITS
ordersText.general: After you resolve this order, you may purchase 1 unit and place it on the world with the factory you moved. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: FLESH IS WEAK
ordersText.general: Enemy bastions do not prevent this orbital strike. During this orbital strike, you may spend 2 [S]. If you do and there are no enemy units or bastions on this world after resolving this orbital strike, take control of all structures on this world. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

eventsText.title: THE QUEST FOR KNOWLEDGE
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* At the end of the Planning Phase, you may discard this card to take 1 of your order tokens from the top of a stack and place it in an adjacent system you are allowed to place order tokens in, either on the top of a stack or beginning a new one.

eventsText.title: BATTLE FORGES
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* When you reveal an order during the Operations Phase, you may discard this card to purchase a factory and place it on a friendly world in the active system.

eventsText.title: NECROMECHANIC
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* When you skip your turn during the Operations Phase, you may discard this card to draw 2 cards from the top of your event deck and resolve their abilities.

eventsText.title: RAD-BOMBARDMENT
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Before you perform an orbital strike, you may discard this card to reduce the health value of enemy units on the world by 1 during this orbital strike. Units with their health value reduced to 0 are destroyed immediately.

eventsText.title: LINGUA-TECHNIS
eventsText.general: Purchase 1 order upgrade, reducing its materiel cost by 1 for each friendly world containing a factory.

eventsText.title: SACRAMENT OF COMMITMENT
eventsText.general: Choose a friendly world with a maximum of 1 asset icon. Place an asset token from the supply on that world's banner. That world gains that asset icon.

eventsText.title: BLESSING OF THE MACHINE GOD
eventsText.general: Gain 1 cache token and 1 forge token.

eventsText.title: MECHAMORPHOSIS
eventsText.general: Replace 1 Skitarii with 1 free Kataphron, replace 1 Kataphron with 1 free Onager, or spend 1 forge token to replace 1 Onager with 1 free Warlord Titan.

combatText.title: SKITARII RANGERS
combatText.general: Either gain 1 [D] or resolve the general abilities of your faceup combat card played in the previous execution round.
combatText.unit: Skitarii/Light Cruiser: Gain 1 (S).

combatText.title: TECH-PRIEST ENGINEER
combatText.general: Either rally 1 of your units or gain 1 (B) and 1 (S).
combatText.unit: Skitarii/Light Cruiser: Gain 1 [S].

combatText.title: SKITARII VANGUARD
combatText.general: Gain 2 (S).
combatText.unit: Skitarii/Light Cruiser: During the assess damage step of this execution round, you may assign damage to your routed units.

combatText.title: SICARIAN INFILTRATORS
combatText.general: If you are attacking, look at your opponent's facedown combat card. *newpara* Gain either 1 [B] or 1 [S].
combatText.unit: Skitarii/Light Cruiser: Gain 1 [M], 2 (B), or 2 (S).

combatText.title: SICARIAN RUSTSTALKERS
combatText.general: Gain 1 [B].
combatText.unit: Skitarii/Light Cruiser: Either gain 1 [M] or choose 1 of your unrouted units to gain (B) equal to the chosen unit's command level.

combatText.title: TRANSCENDENT COGITATION
combatText.unit: Skitarii/Light Cruiser: Force your opponent to lose 1 [B], 1 [S], or 1 [M]. Then gain 1 [B], 1 [S], or 1 [M], whichever your opponent lost.

combatText.title: ENHANCED BIONICS
combatText.general: Gain either 1 [B] or 1 (B).
combatText.unit: Kataphron/Light Cruiser: Gain 2 (S) unless your opponent spends 1 [S].

combatText.title: AGGRESSION OVERRIDE
combatText.general: Gain either 1 [S] or 1 (S).
combatText.unit: Kataphron/Light Cruiser: Gain 2 (B) unless your opponent spends 1 [B].

combatText.title: SIPHONED VIGOUR
combatText.general: Convert 1 of your dice into [M]. *newpara* Either gain 1 [D] or resolve the unit abilities of your faceup combat card played in the previous execution round.

combatText.title: MACHINE SUPERIORITY
combatText.general: Gain 1 [D], 2 (B), or 2 (S). *newpara* Spend 1 forge token to rally all of your units.
combatText.unit: Onager/Ark Mechanicus: Choose [B], [S] or [M]. Force your opponent to convert up to 2 of the chosen dice to a different icon of your choice.

combatText.title: MANOEUVRABLE CRAFT
combatText.general: Convert up to 2 of your [B] into [M]. *newpara* Spend 1 [M] to gain 3 (S).
combatText.unit: Onager/Ark Mechanicus: Do not discard your (S) at the end of this execution round.

combatText.title: ELIMINATION VOLLEY
combatText.general: Gain 1 (B).
combatText.unit: Skitarii/Kataphron/Onager: Rout 1 of your opponent's units. This unit's command level cannot exceed the command level of your unrouted unit with the highest command level.

combatText.title: MACHINE SPIRIT'S REVENGE
combatText.general: Gain either 1 [S] or 1 (S). *newline* Convert up to 2 of your [B] into [S].
combatText.unit: Titan/Ark Mechanicus: If your units or bastions suffer no damage during this execution round, rout 1 of your opponent's units. *newpara* Spend 2 of your dice to destroy either 1 command level 0 unit or 1 structure in the contested area.

combatText.title: RAGE OF THE MACHINE
combatText.general: Gain 3 (B).
combatText.unit: Titan/Ark Mechanicus: Do not discard your (B) at the end of this execution round.

ordersText.title: SLAVE RAID
ordersText.general: If you rolled at least 2 [B] during this orbital strike, gain 1 reinforcement token. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: MALEVOLENCE MADE FLESH
ordersText.general: After you resolve this order, you may either spend 1 reinforcement token to place 1 free Kabalite Warrior on any friendly world or replace 1 Kabalite Warrior in the active system with 1 free Wych. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: WEB OF TORMENT
ordersText.general: While resolving this order, you may move your units from any number of systems adjacent to the active system. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: POWER FROM PAIN
ordersText.general: While resolving this order, increase your command level by 1. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: ECLIPSING DESCENT
ordersText.general: Enemy bastions do not prevent this orbital strike. During this orbital strike, you may spend 1 [B] to move 1 of your ships in the active system to another void in the active system. This can start a new combat after resolving this orbital strike. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

eventsText.title: REALSPACE RAID
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Instead of revealing an order during the Operations Phase, you may discard this card to choose an uncontrolled world. Gain assets from this world and gain materiel equal to its materiel value.

eventsText.title: SHADOWFIELD PROJECTION
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* While resolving an Advance Order, you may discard this card to perform its steps in any order. You may not create contested area after Resolved Combat step.

eventsText.title: REVEL IN BLOODSHED
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* At the end of an execution round of combat, you may discard this card and destroy 1 of your command level 1 or command level 2 units to move any number of your units to an adjacent area. This can start a new combat after resolving this combat.

eventsText.title: VISIONS OF COMMORRAGH
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Instead of placing an order during the Planning Phase, you may discard this card.

eventsText.title: SLAVE TRADE
eventsText.general: Either spend up to 2 materiel to gain 1 asset of your choice for each materiel you spend or spend up to 2 assets to gain 2 materiel for each asset you spend.

eventsText.title: GRISLY TROPHIES
eventsText.general: Destroy 1 of your units on any world. Gain materiel equal to its materiel cost and gain reinforcement tokens equal to its morale value.

eventsText.title: SPECTACLE OF MURDER
eventsText.general: Purchase 1 combat upgrade. You may spend reinforcement tokens to reduce its materiel cost by 2 for each token you spend.

eventsText.title: BLACK HEART SPONSORING
eventsText.general: Either place 1 free Frigate on a friendly void or spend 2 materiel and 1 forge token to replace 1 Frigate with 1 free Dying Sun Battleship.

combatText.title: PREY ON THE WEAK
combatText.general: Either gain 1 [B] or spend 1 of your dice to rally 1 of your units.
combatText.unit: Kabalite Warrior/Frigate: Gain 1 [D].

combatText.title: AGENTS OF VECT
combatText.general: Gain 1 [S]. *newpara* If you have at least 1 unrouted ship in the active system, gain 1 reinforcement token and force your opponent to discard 1 of his reinforcement tokens.
combatText.unit: Kabalite Warrior: Spend 1 of your reinforcement tokents to place 1 free reinforcement token in this area.

combatText.title: HUNT FROM THE SHADOWS
combatText.unit: Kabalite Warrior/Frigate: Your opponent may retreat 1 of his units. If he does not, gain 1 (B) for each unrouted Kabalite Warrior or Frigate. *newpara* Discard this card to retreat 1 of your units.

combatText.title: FUELLED BY HATRED
combatText.general: Gain 1 (B). *newpara* Convert 1 of your [M] into [B].
combatText.unit: Kabalite Warrior/Wych/Frigate: Gain 1 (S). *newpara* Your opponent rerolls 1 die of your choice.

combatText.title: WINGED STRIKE
combatText.general: Either gain 1 (B) or draw 1 combat card.
combatText.unit: Wych/Frigate: Either gain 2 (S) or play 1 combat card from your hand. Do not resolve its abilities, but gain its combat icons during this combat.

combatText.title: ECSTATIC CARNAGE
combatText.general: Gain 2 (B) unless your opponent spends 1 [S].
combatText.unit: Wych/Frigate: Spend 1 of your dice to gain either 1 [B] and 1 (S) or 1 [S] and 1 (B).

combatText.title: RAIDER TACTICS
combatText.general: If you are attacking, gain 2 (B). The first time 1 of your units is destroyed during the assess damage step of this execution round, you may retreat that unit instead. *newpara* If you are defending, gain 2 (S). When an enemy unit is routed during this execution round, it is destroyed unless your opponent spends 1 [M].

combatText.title: FIRE AND FADE
combatText.general: Gain either 1 [B] or 1 [S].
combatText.unit: Kabalite Warrior/Frigate: Your opponent may retreat 1 of his units. Then you may move 1 of your units to an adjacent friendly or uncontrolled area. If you do, gain either 1 [M] or 2 (B).

combatText.title: NEVER STATIONARY
combatText.general: If you are attacking, your opponent cannot gain (B) during this execution round. *newpara* If you are defending, gain 1 [S] and your opponent loses 2 (B).
combatText.unit: Wych/Frigate: Spend 1 [M] to place 1 free reinforcement token in this area.

combatText.title: CRUCIBLE OF MALEDICTION
combatText.general: Force your opponent to lose 1 [M]. *newpara* During this combat, your opponent cannot gain or spend [M].

combatText.title: HARROWING EMBRACE
combatText.general: Your opponent may retreat 1 of his units. If he does not, force your opponent to lose either 1 [B] or 1 [M].
combatText.unit: Ravager/Dying Sun: If you have fewer [M] than your opponent, your opponent loses 1 [M]. Otherwise, gain 2 (B) and 1 (S).

combatText.title: PICK THEM APART
combatText.general: Your opponent may retreat 1 of his units. If he does not, force your opponent to lose either 1 [S] or 1 [M].
combatText.unit: Ravager/Dying Sun: Gain 1 (B) and 2 (S) unless your opponent chooses and destroys 1 of his units.

combatText.title: RAIN OF CRUELTY
combatText.general: Move either 1 Ravager or 1 of your ships from an area in either the active system or an adjacent system to this area. If you do, gain 2 [D].
combatText.unit: Ravager: Place 1 free reinforcement token in this area. *newline* Force your opponent to lose 1 [S]. *newpara* Dying Sun: Gain 2 (B).

combatText.title: MALICIOUS FRENZY
combatText.general: Gain 2 (B), 2 (S), or spend 1 of your dice to gain 2 (B) and 2 (S).
combatText.unit: Ravager/Dying Sun: Force your opponent to lose 1 [B], 1 [S], and 1 [M].

ordersText.title: DREAD JUDGEMENT
ordersText.general: At the start of the resolution step of a combat you start with this order, you may force your opponent to choose and destroy 1 of his routed units in the contested area. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: PURGING BANNERS
ordersText.general: After purchasing units while resolving this order, you may move 1 of those units to a friendly or uncontrolled area in an adjacent system. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: SIGILS OF REVELATION
ordersText.general: When you reveal this order token, you may look at all order tokens in any stack. Then you may discard 1 of your order tokens from that stack to place 2 of your order tokens from your play area onto the top of your event deck. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: TERROR STRIKE
ordersText.general: Enemy bastions do not prevent this orbital strike. During this orbital strike, you may spend 2 [S] to force your opponent to choose and retreat 1 of his units on this world, as if it was a defender. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: INEVITABLE EXECUTION
ordersText.general: During this orbital strike, gain 1 [D]. You may resolve this orbital strike against any world in the active system. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

eventsText.title: VIOLENT ACQUISITION
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* After you resolve an Advance Order, you may discard this card to collect an Inquisition objective token that is on a friendly world in the active system.

eventsText.title: PSIONIC WARFARE
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* When you reveal an order during the Operations Phase, you may discard this card to choose an order upgrade card in any player's play area. That order upgrade card is considered used during this round.

eventsText.title: STRATEGIC EXCRUCIATION
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Instead of revealing an order during the Operations Phase, you may discard this card to discard a scheme from another player's play area.

eventsText.title: THEOSOPHAMY
eventsText.general: Discard this card.

eventsText.title: RADICALS AND PURITANS
eventsText.general: Either purchase 1 structure, reducing its cost materiel by 1, and place it on a friendly world not containing a structure, or destroy 1 of your structures on any world to gain materiel equal to its materiel cost increased by 1.

eventsText.title: ELYSIAN DROP TROOPS
eventsText.general: Either place 1 free Stormtrooper on an uncontrolled world in a system containing at least 1 of your ships or place 1 free Stormtrooper on any friendly world.

eventsText.title: MINISTORUM'S DOGMA
eventsText.general: Purchase 1 combat upgrade, reducing its materiel cost by 1 for each system with no enemy units, to a minimum of 1.

eventsText.title: IMPERIAL MANDATE
eventsText.general: Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* After placing your first order token during the Planning Phase, you may discard this card to place 1 additional order token. If you do, you place 5 order tokens during this Planning Phase.

combatText.title: BLINDING SALVO
combatText.general: If you are attacking, your opponent cannot resolve the general abilities of his next revealed combat card. *newpara* If you are defending, gain 1 [D].

combatText.title: SHADOW ASSIGNMENT
combatText.general: Gain 1 [M]. *newpara* Rally 1 of your units.
combatText.unit: Stormtrooper/Rogue Trader: If you have more [M] than your opponent, force your opponent to either choose and rout 1 of his units or to spend a die of your choice.

combatText.title: PSYKER SHIELD
combatText.general: Gain 2 (S).
combatText.unit: Deathwatch/Rogue Trader: Spend 2 (S) to place 1 free reinforcement token in this area.

combatText.title: UNQUESTIONABLE WISDOM
combatText.general: Gain either 1 [B] or 1 [S].
combatText.unit: Stormtrooper/Rogue Trader: Discard 1 combat card from your hand. Gain that card's combat icons until the end of this execution round.

combatText.title: FRENZON IMPLANTS
combatText.general: Gain 2 (B).
combatText.unit: Stormtrooper/Rogue Trader: Spend 2 (B) to convert all of your [M] into [B].

combatText.title: SANCTIONED PSYKER
combatText.general: Your opponent may spend 1 [B] to gain 1 (B). If he does not, force your opponent to lose 1 [S].
combatText.unit: Stormtrooper/Rogue Trader: Your opponent rerolls 2 dice of his choice. For each [B] rolled, gain 1 (B) and 1 (S). For each [S] rolled, gain 1 (S).

combatText.title: UNFLINCHING CRUSADERS
combatText.general: Gain 2 (B).
combatText.unit: Deathwatch/Rogue Trader: If you are defending, rally 1 of your units. *newpara* Force your opponent to lose either 1 [S] or 2 (B).

combatText.title: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
combatText.general: Gain 2 (S).
combatText.unit: Deathwatch/Rogue Trader: If you are attacking, rally 1 of your units. *newpara* Spend 1 [S] to gain 2 (B).

combatText.title: FAITH GUIDANCE
combatText.general: If you are attacking, your opponent cannot resolve the unit abilities of his next revealed combat card. *newpara* If you are defending, either gain 1 | or retreat 1 of your units.

combatText.title: LIDLESS STARE
combatText.general: Gain 1 [D].
combatText.unit: Deathwatch/Black Ship: Your opponent loses 3 dice of his choice. Then you lose 3 of your dice. Gain 1 [D].

combatText.title: STORM ENVOY
combatText.general: Reroll either 1 [B] or 1 [M] to force your opponent to lose 1 [B].
combatText.unit: Valkyrie: Take 1 Stormtrooper from any world and place it on this world. *newpara* Black Ship: Take 1 Stormtrooper from any world and place it on a friendly or uncontrolled world in this system.

combatText.title: HELLSTRIKE MISSILES
combatText.general: Reroll either 1 [S] or 1 [M] to force your opponent to lose 1 [S].
combatText.unit: Valkyrie/Black Ship: Destroy 1 of your opponent's routed units.

combatText.title: TRUESILVER ARMOUR
combatText.general: Gain either 1 [S] or 2 (S).
combatText.unit: Grey Knight/Black Ship: During this combat, the health value of your units is increased by 1.

combatText.title: DEEP STRIKE
combatText.general: Either gain 1 (B) or convert up to 3 of your dice into [B].
combatText.unit: Grey Knight: When an enemy unit suffers damage during this execution round, it is destroyed. *newpara* Black Ship: Rout 1 of your opponent's units.
